Stay informed with the detailed collectosk stickers & cards release calendar, covering all upcoming sticker and trading card releases from Panini, Topps, Upper Deck, Leaf, Rittenhouse, and many other manufacturers from the sports and entertainment sectors.

The listed dates generally refer to the hobby release date. For stickers and trading card games released internationally at different times, the earliest release date is decisive. Any differing release dates for specific products within a collection or for other countries can be found, if available, in the respective article.

Collections that have been announced but do not yet have a specific release date are marked with “TBD” (to be determined) and are listed at the end of the calendar.

Annual Overviews

You can find a comprehensive overview of all releases for a given year in the separate annual overviews, which you can access using the buttons below:

2026
2025
2024

Upcoming Releases List

The list below shows the releases from the past week as well as upcoming collections. Please note that manufacturers may change release dates at any time – sometimes at very short notice – and this happens quite regularly.

Use the filter fields to narrow down the list by date range, keywords, or categories to quickly find specific collections. If a checklist for a collection is already available, you’ll recognize it by the green check mark in the right column. Clicking the check mark will take you directly to the checklist.
